purpose: Define the exact external evidence required before claiming a full 100% live-proven GEO topic run beyond local, fixture, manual-import, or approval-gated proof.

status_semantics.local_pass: The local GEO workflow artifacts prove the workflow in offline, fixture, manual-import, or approval-gated form.
status_semantics.external_pending: The implementation exists, but the proof requires explicit user approval, credentials, budget, network access, target data, or independent reviewers.
status_semantics.external_pass: The required external run or independent audit has completed and produced bounded evidence artifacts.
status_semantics.descoped: The user explicitly accepted that this evidence is out of scope for the current release, with reason and date.
status_semantics.ready_with_descopes: All required external evidence items are either external_pass or user-descoped. This permits a limited release claim with explicit limitations, not a full live-proven claim.

required_external_evidence.current_local_status: adapter, dry-run plan, raw XML parser fixture, normalized SERP/AI rows, topic-bound collection summary, raw_ref linkage validator, and report paths are implemented

budget_scope: requested top URL count (`--depth`, not pagination pages)
paid XMLRiver page request count = query count * engine count * ceil(depth / 10)

required_evidence_artifacts: geo_agent/data/quality-gates/external_approval_ledger.json with approved_by, approval_ref, approved_at, topic_slug, scope, and budget/request limits
geo_agent/data/raw/serp/<run_id>/*.xml referenced by live CSV raw_ref
geo_agent/data/processed/*_live_ai_answers.csv when AI blocks are returned, with valid raw_ref
required_external_evidence.pass_condition: At least one approved XMLRiver live request completes for the approved topic/scope, collection_summary.json is bound to the same topic_slug with network_approved=true, explicit region/language/engines, requested_top_urls, xmlriver_serp_pages_per_query_engine, planned_paid_requests, XMLRiver reference files, and errors=[], raw XML is preserved, every live CSV raw_ref resolves to an existing raw file inside the approved run directory, organic rows are normalized, and completion audit records no live-provider warning for that approved scope. A matching external approval ledger row must record scope and budget before the live evidence can count as external_pass.
required_external_evidence.forbidden_claim_until_pass: Do not claim that XMLRiver live data was collected in a target project.

required_external_evidence.current_local_status: Google Organic Live Advanced adapter, dry-run plan, parser fixture, AI Overview reference parsing, topic-bound collection summary, raw_ref linkage validator, and budget gate are implemented

budget_scope: requested top URL count (`--depth`, not pagination pages)

required_evidence_artifacts: geo_agent/data/quality-gates/external_approval_ledger.json with approved_by, approval_ref, approved_at, topic_slug, scope, and budget/request limits
geo_agent/data/raw/serp/<run_id>/*.json referenced by live CSV raw_ref
geo_agent/data/processed/*_live_ai_answers.csv when AI Overview or answer rows are returned, with valid raw_ref
required_external_evidence.pass_condition: At least one approved DataForSEO Google Organic Live request completes for the approved topic/scope, collection_summary.json is bound to the same topic_slug with network_approved=true and errors=[], raw JSON is preserved, every live CSV raw_ref resolves to an existing raw file inside the approved run directory, SERP rows are normalized, AI rows are normalized when present, and completion audit records no live-provider warning for that approved scope. A matching external approval ledger row must record scope and budget before the live evidence can count as external_pass.
required_external_evidence.forbidden_claim_until_pass: Do not claim that DataForSEO live data was collected in a target project.

required_external_evidence.current_local_status: approval gate, planned URL report, live URL enrichment summary, raw HTML path, raw_ref linkage validator, chunk signal extraction, and no-network blocked observation are implemented
required_evidence_artifacts: geo_agent/data/quality-gates/external_approval_ledger.json with approved_by, approval_ref, approved_at, topic_slug, scope, and budget/request limits
required_external_evidence.pass_condition: Approved and ledger-recorded target URLs are fetched, URL enrichment summary is bound to the same topic_slug with network_approved=true and enriched_rows>0, each successful row raw_ref resolves to an existing raw page file under geo_agent/data/raw/pages, URL_ENRICHMENT.md summarizes page type, main content, chunk, WAF/JS risks, the run respects max URL bounds, and completion audit records no warnings or blocks for that approved scope.
required_external_evidence.forbidden_claim_until_pass: Do not claim live URL/page enrichment was completed for a target site.

required_external_evidence.current_local_status: independent audit pack, self-review reports, structured summary validator, and markdown-only guard are implemented; actual independent execution is not claimed
required_command_patterns: Run approved independent scenario and clean-audit reviewers against the current GEO project artifacts and allowed agent references.

Record reviewer results in geo_agent/data/quality-gates/independent-review-summary.json with independent_execution=true, 6 scenario reviews, 4 auditor reviews, work traces, inspected files, and closed finding dispositions.
required_external_evidence.pass_condition: Independent evaluators inspect the GEO project artifacts and allowed agent references without being given intended fixes; independent-review-summary.json records independent_execution=true, all six scenario review ids, all four auditor review ids, reviewer ids, inspected files, work traces, all_findings_dispositioned=true, and every finding is fixed, rejected with reason, known limitation, or not applicable.
required_external_evidence.forbidden_claim_until_pass: Do not claim independent GEO workflow review.

final_claim_rule: A full 100% live-proven claim requires every required_external_evidence item to be external_pass. A limited 100% readiness claim may use ready_with_descopes only when every non-passed item is explicitly descoped by the user with reason and date; descoped rows are limitations, not live evidence. Until then, claim only the validated GEO workflow artifacts and the exact accepted evidence from the evidence ledger.
forbidden_global_claims_until_external_p: live XMLRiver or DataForSEO collection was executed in the target project
live URL enrichment was completed for target pages
independent GEO workflow review was completed

decision_record_contract.rule: A descope decision removes an item from external_pending only when it has id, decision=descoped, approved_by, reason, and date. It never increments external_pass and never proves live execution.
